title: The fields of a job file
description: Every field a job file may hold, with its type, range and pattern: one format for a chat's job and for a file from the repo (the working folder's jobs/<name>.json). job-chat.schema.json and job-repo.schema.json say which of these a file must, may and may not have, and which values. A schema cannot say, and the add-on's and the gate's checks keep: the file's name, a key written twice, `end` at most 28 days after `created` and not before it, at most 10 enabled jobs, that a file from the repo is changed by the chat only within the repo's fields in place, and that a result is newer than its run.

agent.description: The agent that runs the job: a name. A chat's file may name only job-private, job-web or job-all (job-chat.schema.json); a file from the repo names its own agent.

task.description: Text added to the run's first message, 1 to 4000 characters.

description.description: Text for the view, when the task is not the one to show.

quarterTime.description: A local time on a quarter hour.

days.description: The weekdays the job runs on; every day when absent.

everyHours.description: Run every this many hours, 4 to 24.

notify.description: The condition under which the run's result tells the phone, at most 500 characters.

timeout.description: The run's time limit in seconds, at most the add-on's ceiling 3600.

max_turns.description: The run's turn limit, at most the add-on's ceiling 100.

context.description: Named lines for the first message: handover (today's handover file), jobs (the Jobs line).

after.description: Named steps after the run: clear_chat.

run_by.description: While step B is under way: automation or jobs. Removed with the last move.
